attributes.action: We need to have an election due to Keir Starmer resigning
attributes.background: Any PM who resigns should not be followed by a member of their party by succession. The public vote for PM not the party, deciding who becomes next PM.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
